name: Family Members Policy (Family Reunification)

requirements.blocker_text: Sponsor must hold a Malta residence permit valid for at least one year and wait 12 calendar months from initial permit issuance before applying; applications submitted earlier are inadmissible.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 12 months of Malta residence before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: Sponsor needs annual income of at least EUR18,940 (national median wage) plus 20% per additional family member, from employment, pension, benefits, rental income, or allowances, all declared with the Revenue Commissioner.
requirements.fix_path: Increase documented sponsor income to the required threshold.

requirements.blocker_text: Eligible relatives: spouse aged 21+ in a monogamous marriage; unmarried minor children (including adoptions recognised under Maltese law); and unmarried adult children with demonstrated financial or physical dependency.

evidence_required.document: Sponsor's proof of residence duration and income (6 months of payslips/documentation)
Civil status certificates (marriage/birth) proving the relationship
Health insurance of at least EUR100,000 covering the permit's full validity

outcome.duration_length: tied to the sponsor's own residence permit validity

sources.title: Identità -- Expatriates Unit: Family Members Policy, eligible relatives, 12-month sponsor wait, EUR18,940+20%/dependant income test, EUR100,000 health insurance, 60-day processing

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Malta's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. A Key Employee Initiative / Specialist Employee Initiative income exception lets qualifying high-earner sponsors (EUR50,000+ gross income for sponsor plus one dependant, plus EUR6,000 per additional dependant, plus mandatory EUR100,000 health insurance per family member) apply sooner than the standard 12-month wait -- confirmed at tier-1 but not modelled as a separate requirement group here since the source frames it as an income-based exception to the same policy rather than a genuinely distinct legal route. Applications are rejected if the family member is already present in Malta, except minor children born there. Decisions issued within 60 days. work_rights for the reunified family member set to 'restricted' as a conservative placeholder: the tier-1 page did not specify the work-rights regime for admitted family members. pr_after_months / citizenship_after_months left null: no independently confirmed figure links this route to a specific timeline for mt_long_term_residence or mt_naturalisation.
